# Ooma

> Ooma provides business communications solutions for organizations of all sizes, from small and midsize businesses to large enterprises. Solutions include business phone systems, UCaaS, AI-powered call management, business internet, and POTS replacement with Ooma AirDial, along with residential VoIP and purpose-built home phone products such as MyPhone and StarDial.

## Quick start

- [Ooma homepage](https://www.ooma.com/): Homepage.
- [Ooma business communications](https://www.ooma.com/business/): Business communications solutions for organizations of all sizes, from small and midsize businesses to large enterprises.
- [Business phone systems](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/): Cloud business phone systems and communications for organizations ranging from small and midsize businesses to enterprises.
- [Ooma Office plans](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/plans/): Compare Ooma business phone plans and features from Essentials through Enterprise.
- [Ooma AI Suite](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/ooma-ai-suite/): AI-powered business communication capabilities including call transcription, AI answering, AI receptionist, and conversation insights.
- [Enterprise communications](https://www.ooma.com/enterprise-communications/): Enterprise communications and custom UCaaS solutions for larger organizations with complex business communication needs.
- [Ooma AirDial POTS line replacement](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/): Overview of Ooma AirDial POTS line replacement product and service.
- [MyPhone for Kids](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/myphone/): Overview of MyPhone by Ooma, a screen-free residential phone service designed for kids and families.
- [Ooma StarDial](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/starlink/stardial/): StarDial home phone solution designed for Starlink users and compatible with any internet provider.
- [Home phone service](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/): VoIP home phone service and landline alternative.

## Business phone systems and communications

- [Business phone systems](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/): Cloud business phone systems and communications for organizations ranging from small and midsize businesses to enterprises.
- [Ooma Office features](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/features/): Details on features available for Ooma Office business phone service plans.
- [Ooma Office plans](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/plans/): Compare Ooma business phone plans and features from Essentials through Enterprise.
- [Ooma Office Pro](https://www.ooma.com/office/pro/): Pro plan details for Ooma Office business phone service.
- [Ooma Office Pro Plus](https://www.ooma.com/office/pro-plus/): Ooma Office Pro Plus plan with AI Transcriptions, AI Insights, CRM integrations, and expanded business communication features.
- [Ooma Office starter kits](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/starter-kits/): Bundled IP phones and business phone service options for smaller businesses.

## Business AI features

- [Ooma AI Suite](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/ooma-ai-suite/): AI-powered business communication capabilities that help answer calls and capture, summarize, and surface important business conversations.
- [AI Transcriptions](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/ai-transcriptions/): AI-powered call transcription and summaries for business calls.
- [AI Answering Service and AI Receptionist](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/ai-answering-service-ai-receptionist/): AI voice agents for business calls. AI Answering Service handles missed calls, customer questions, and message capture, while AI Receptionist can answer every call, route callers, schedule appointments, and handle more complex inquiries.
- [AI Insights](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/ai-insights/): AI-powered conversation analytics for call topics, trends, sentiment, and performance metrics, with Ask AI for natural-language questions about customer conversations.
- [Ooma Office OpenAI integration](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/integrations/openai/): OpenAI integration information for Ooma Office users.

## Business phone service integrations

- [Ooma Office integrations](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/integrations/): Integrations compatible with Ooma Office business phone service.
- [Ooma Office OpenAI integration](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/integrations/openai/): OpenAI integration information for Ooma Office, including transcription-related workflows.

## Business phone service resources

- [Business case studies](https://www.ooma.com/business/case-studies/): Case studies for Ooma business phone service.
- [Ooma Office reviews](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/reviews/): Reviews from users of Ooma Office business phone service.

## Business phone service support

- [Ooma Office resources and support](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/resources/): Resource hub for Ooma Office applications, downloads, devices, FAQs, and support topics.
- [Ooma Office getting started support](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/get-started/): Getting started articles and guides for Ooma Office setup and use.
- [Ooma Office troubleshooting support](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/troubleshooting/): Troubleshooting articles for Ooma Office audio, devices, faxing, features, integrations, network issues, and general issues.
- [Ooma Office manuals and guides](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/manuals-guides/): Manuals and guides for Ooma Office IP phones, base stations, adapters, and related devices.

## Business IP phone products

- [Business IP phones and adapters](https://www.ooma.com/small-business-phone-systems/buy/): Shopping page for business IP desk phones and adapters.

## Industries served with business services

- [Business phone services by industry](https://www.ooma.com/business/phone-services/by-industry/): Examples of industries using Ooma Office business phone services.

## Business phone numbers by location

- [Business phone numbers](https://www.ooma.com/phone-numbers/): Get a business phone number by popular area code.
- [Business phone numbers in Arizona](https://www.ooma.com/locations/arizona/): Get a business phone number in Arizona.
- [Business phone numbers in California](https://www.ooma.com/locations/california/): Get a business phone number in California.
- [Business phone numbers in Colorado](https://www.ooma.com/locations/colorado/): Get a business phone number in Colorado.
- [Business phone numbers in Connecticut](https://www.ooma.com/locations/connecticut/): Get a business phone number in Connecticut.

## Business internet

- [Ooma Connect business internet](https://www.ooma.com/business-internet/): Overview of Ooma Connect business internet service.

## Enterprise communications

- [Enterprise communications](https://www.ooma.com/enterprise-communications/): Enterprise communications and custom UCaaS solutions for larger organizations with complex business communication needs.

## AirDial POTS replacement

- [Ooma AirDial POTS line replacement](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/): Overview of Ooma AirDial POTS line replacement product and service.
- [POTS retirement resources](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/pots-retirement/): Resources for organizations navigating copper network changes, rising POTS line costs, carrier notices, compliance requirements, critical system issues, inspections, and landline service discontinuation.
- [Got a POTS shutdown notice?](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/pots-retirement/pots-shutdown-notice/): Guidance for organizations that receive a carrier notice about POTS line or copper network retirement.
- [Replacing POTS lines for compliance](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/pots-retirement/replacing-pots-lines-for-compliance/): Guidance on replacing legacy POTS lines while accounting for communication, backup power, code, and compliance requirements.
- [AirDial compliance](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/compliance/): Compliance information for Ooma AirDial POTS replacement.
- [AirDial remote device management](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/remote-device-management/): Remote device management for Ooma AirDial.
- [AirDial business case builder](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/build-business-case/): Business case builder for POTS line replacement.
- [AirDial deployment](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/deployment/): Deployment, installation, and ongoing support information for Ooma AirDial.
- [AirDial FAQs](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/faqs/): Frequently asked questions for Ooma AirDial POTS replacement.
- [AirDial case studies](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/resources/case-studies/): POTS replacement case studies.
- [AirDial datasheets](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/resources/datasheets/): POTS replacement datasheets by industry.
- [AirDial videos](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/resources/videos/): POTS replacement videos.
- [AirDial webinars and podcasts](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/resources/webinars/): POTS replacement webinars and podcasts.
- [Elevator emergency phone POTS replacement](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/elevator-emergency-phones/): Information on POTS line replacement for elevator emergency phones.
- [Fire alarm panel POTS replacement](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/fire-alarm-panels/): Information on POTS line replacement for fire alarm panels.
- [AirDial technical specifications](https://www.ooma.com/business/airdial-pots-line-replacement/technical-specifications/): Technical specifications for Ooma AirDial.

## Residential services and plans

- [Home phone service](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/): VoIP home phone service and landline alternative.
- [Home phone plans](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone/plans/): Compare plans and features for Ooma home phone service.
- [Ooma Basic home phone plan](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/basic/): Basic plan details for Ooma home phone service.
- [Ooma Premier home phone plan](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/premier/): Premier plan details for Ooma home phone service.

## MyPhone by Ooma

- [MyPhone for Kids](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/myphone/): Overview of MyPhone by Ooma, a screen-free residential phone service designed for kids and families.
- [MyPhone features](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/myphone/myphone-features/): Details on MyPhone features such as Trusted Circle, Quiet Hours, address-based 911, call logs, voicemail, and parental controls.
- [Buy MyPhone](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/myphone/buy/): Shopping page for MyPhone devices and service bundles.
- [MyPhone setup and support](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/myphone/support/): Setup, activation, parental controls, contact management, and troubleshooting for MyPhone.
- [MyPhone community and parent resources](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/myphone/community/): Parent resources, blog posts, downloads, and guidance for families using MyPhone.

## StarDial and Starlink home phone service

- [Ooma StarDial](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/starlink/stardial/): StarDial home phone solution designed for Starlink users and compatible with any internet provider.
- [Phone service for Starlink](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/starlink/): Overview of Ooma VoIP phone service built to work with Starlink satellite internet.

## Residential products

- [MyPhone for Kids](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/myphone/): Screen-free residential phone service and device bundle for kids and families.
- [Ooma StarDial](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/starlink/stardial/): Home phone solution designed for Starlink users, with a StarDial Base Station and HD3 cordless handset.
- [All home phone products](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/buy/): Shop Ooma home phone devices, bundles, accessories, and service plans.
- [Phones for seniors](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/seniors/): VoIP phones designed for easy use by seniors and aging adults.
- [Retro phones](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone/retro-phones/): Retro-style VoIP phones bundled with Ooma Telo.
- [Household phone bundle](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/household-phone-bundle/): Home phone bundle for households that want simple, reliable calling.
- [Home office phones](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/home-office-phones/): VoIP desk phones for home offices and remote workers.
- [Home phone accessories](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/accessories/): Accessories for Ooma home phone devices and service.

## Residential phone numbers by location

- [Choose a home phone number](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/choose-phone-number/): Choose a phone number for Ooma home phone service.
- [Home phone service in Alabama](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/alabama/): Landline alternative home phone service in Alabama.
- [Home phone service in Alaska](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/alaska/): Landline alternative home phone service in Alaska.
- [Home phone service in Arizona](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/arizona/): Landline alternative home phone service in Arizona.

## Residential phone service resources

- [Home phone resources and support](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/resources/): Support hub for home phone setup, activation, troubleshooting, devices, features, videos, and resources.
- [Consumer Reports information](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/consumer-reports/): Consumer Reports information for Ooma home phone service.
- [Home phone service reviews](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/reviews/): Reviews from Ooma home phone service customers.

## Residential support

- [Home phone resources and support](https://www.ooma.com/home-phone-service/resources/): Support for Ooma home phone products, setup, devices, features, and troubleshooting.

## Blog

- [Ooma blog](https://www.ooma.com/blog/): Blog hub for business, residential, AirDial, and enterprise communication topics.
- [Business blog](https://www.ooma.com/blog/business/): Hub for business blog topics.
- [Home phone blog](https://www.ooma.com/blog/home-phone/): Hub for home phone and residential blog topics.
- [AirDial blog](https://www.ooma.com/blog/business/?tag=airdial): Business blog posts about Ooma AirDial, POTS replacement, remote device management, and copper line replacement.

## Company information

- [About Ooma](https://www.ooma.com/company/): Company information about Ooma.
- [Careers](https://www.ooma.com/careers/): Careers and job openings at Ooma.
- [Press releases](https://www.ooma.com/press/): Current and past press releases from Ooma.
- [Ooma AI announcement](https://www.ooma.com/press-release/ooma-introduces-ooma-ai-to-streamline-business-call-management-and-transform-customer-experiences/): Press release announcing Ooma AI capabilities for Ooma Office.
- [MyPhone launch announcement](https://www.ooma.com/press-release/ooma-launches-myphone-a-modern-landline-for-kids-as-parents-delay-smartphones/): Press release announcing MyPhone by Ooma for kids and families.

## Company legal, privacy and policy information

- [Legal information](https://www.ooma.com/legal/): Hub for legal documentation related to Ooma products and services.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.ooma.com/legal/privacy-policy/): Official privacy policy for Ooma.
- [Rates](https://www.ooma.com/legal/rates/): Rate information for Ooma telecommunications services.
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.ooma.com/legal/terms/): Ooma legal terms and conditions.
- [Terms of service](https://www.ooma.com/legal/terms-of-service/): Terms of service hub for Ooma services.

## Contact information

- [Contact Ooma](https://www.ooma.com/contact/): Phone numbers, email, and chat information for Ooma corporate, sales, and customer support.

// GPC (Global Privacy Control) detection -- kept inline and dependency-free so the
// vendor gates below can honour the signal on the very first pageview, before
// CookieYes has loaded. See js-es6/gpc-integration/ for the full integration.
function gpcDetected() {
    try {
        // ?gpc_force=1 simulates the signal for QA; it can only make tracking stricter.
        // The ooma_ prefix is the pre-rename spelling, still accepted. This MUST stay in
        // sync with forceParam/legacyParamPrefix in js-es6/gpc-integration/index.js --
        // if the two drift, ?gpc_force=1 gates VWO without writing the consent, or vice versa.
        if (/[?&](?:ooma_)?gpc_force=1(&|$)/.test(window.location.search)) return true;
        return navigator.globalPrivacyControl === true || navigator.globalPrivacyControl === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

// Reusable function to check CookieYes opt-out status (always defined)
function checkCookieYesOptOut() {

    // A GPC signal is an opt-out regardless of what CookieYes has stored yet.
    if (gpcDetected()) return false;

    var consent = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )cookieyes-consent=([^;]*)/);
    if (!consent) return true;

    try {
        var val = decodeURIComponent(consent[1]);
        var analyticsMatch = val.match(/analytics:([^,]*)/);
        var performanceMatch = val.match(/performance:([^,]*)/);
        var advertisementMatch = val.match(/advertisement:([^,]*)/);

        if ((analyticsMatch && analyticsMatch[1] === 'no') ||
            (advertisementMatch && advertisementMatch[1] === 'no')) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    } catch (e) {}

    return true;
}

                tagButtons();
            }).observe(container, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  function initLottieAnswering(rootId) {
    var root = document.getElementById(rootId);
    if (!root) return;

    var isHomePage = window.location.pathname === '/' ||
      window.location.pathname.startsWith('/biz/') ||
      window.location.pathname.startsWith('/business/') ||
      window.location.pathname.startsWith('/business-voip-dm/') ||
      window.location.pathname.startsWith('/business-voip/');

    var lottieControls = root.querySelector('[data-lottie-controls]');
    if (isHomePage && lottieControls) {
      lottieControls.style.display = 'none';
    }

    fetch('/wp-content/themes/ooma/lib/lottie/lottie.min.js')
      .then(response => response.text())
      .then(code => {
        const wrappedCode = '(function(define, require, exports, module) { ' + code + ' })()';
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.textContent = wrappedCode;
        document.head.appendChild(script);
        const checkLottie = setInterval(function () {
          if (typeof lottie !== 'undefined') {
            clearInterval(checkLottie);

            const anim = lottie.loadAnimation({
              container: root.querySelector('[data-lottie-container]'),
              renderer: 'svg',
              loop: false,
              autoplay: false,
              path: '/wp-content/themes/ooma/images/lottie/ai-answering-service/with-audio/AI-Answering-Service-Audio-482x552-v7a-mark-long.json'
            });

            if (isHomePage) {
              // Home page: animation only, no audio, no controls
              return;
            }

            // Non-home pages: full audio + controls
            ['icon-pause', 'icon-play', 'icon-mute', 'icon-sound'].forEach(function (name) {
              var img = new Image();
              img.src = '/wp-content/themes/ooma/images/icons/ai/' + name + '.svg';
            });

            const audio = new Audio('/wp-content/themes/ooma/images/lottie/ai-answering-service/with-audio/AI-Answering-Service-Audio-482x552-v7a-mark-long.mp3');
            audio.preload = 'auto';
            audio.muted = true;

            let audioStarted = false;

            function restartBoth() {
              audio.currentTime = 0;
              audio.play().then(function () {
                anim.goToAndPlay(0, true);
              }).catch(function () {
                anim.goToAndPlay(0, true);
              });
            }

            const btnPlay = root.querySelector('[data-lottie-btn="play-pause"]');
            const btnMute = root.querySelector('[data-lottie-btn="mute"]');
            let playing = false;

            // Pause this animation when a different one starts playing
            document.addEventListener('lottie:play', function (e) {
              if (e.detail && e.detail.id !== rootId && playing) {
                anim.pause();
                audio.pause();
                btnPlay.classList.replace('lottie-btn-pause', 'lottie-btn-play');
                btnPlay.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play animation');
                playing = false;
              }
            });

            anim.addEventListener('DOMLoaded', function () {
              btnPlay.classList.add('visible');
              btnMute.classList.add('visible');
              // Auto-play (muted) on load
              document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lottie:play', { detail: { id: rootId } }));
              audio.currentTime = 0;
              audio.play().then(function () {
                anim.play();
              }).catch(function () {
                anim.play();
              });
              btnPlay.classList.replace('lottie-btn-play', 'lottie-btn-pause');
              btnPlay.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause animation');
              playing = true;
            });

            anim.addEventListener('complete', function () {
              restartBoth();
            });

            btnPlay.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (playing) {
                anim.pause();
                audio.pause();
                btnPlay.classList.replace('lottie-btn-pause', 'lottie-btn-play');
                btnPlay.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play animation');
              } else {
                document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lottie:play', { detail: { id: rootId } }));
                audio.currentTime = anim.currentFrame / anim.frameRate;
                audio.play().then(function () {
                  anim.play();
                }).catch(function () {
                  anim.play();
                });
                btnPlay.classList.replace('lottie-btn-play', 'lottie-btn-pause');
                btnPlay.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause animation');
              }
              playing = !playing;
            });

            btnMute.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
              e.preventDefault();
              audio.muted = !audio.muted;
              if (!audio.muted) {
                audio.currentTime = anim.currentFrame / anim.frameRate;
                audio.play().then(function () {
                  audioStarted = true;
                }).catch(function () { });
              }
              if (audio.muted) {
                btnMute.classList.replace('lottie-btn-sound', 'lottie-btn-mute');
                btnMute.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Unmute audio');
              } else {
                btnMute.classList.replace('lottie-btn-mute', 'lottie-btn-sound');

              }
            });

// GPC (Global Privacy Control) detection -- kept inline and dependency-free so the
// vendor gates below can honour the signal on the very first pageview, before
// CookieYes has loaded. See js-es6/gpc-integration/ for the full integration.
function gpcDetected() {
    try {
        // ?gpc_force=1 simulates the signal for QA; it can only make tracking stricter.
        // The ooma_ prefix is the pre-rename spelling, still accepted. This MUST stay in
        // sync with forceParam/legacyParamPrefix in js-es6/gpc-integration/index.js --
        // if the two drift, ?gpc_force=1 gates VWO without writing the consent, or vice versa.
        if (/[?&](?:ooma_)?gpc_force=1(&|$)/.test(window.location.search)) return true;
        return navigator.globalPrivacyControl === true || navigator.globalPrivacyControl === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

// Reusable function to check CookieYes opt-out status (always defined)
function checkCookieYesOptOut() {

    // A GPC signal is an opt-out regardless of what CookieYes has stored yet.
    if (gpcDetected()) return false;

    var consent = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )cookieyes-consent=([^;]*)/);
    if (!consent) return true;

    try {
        var val = decodeURIComponent(consent[1]);
        var analyticsMatch = val.match(/analytics:([^,]*)/);
        var performanceMatch = val.match(/performance:([^,]*)/);
        var advertisementMatch = val.match(/advertisement:([^,]*)/);

        if ((analyticsMatch && analyticsMatch[1] === 'no') ||
            (advertisementMatch && advertisementMatch[1] === 'no')) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    } catch (e) {}

    return true;
}
